rune.insanesurvivaloverhaul.critical.des: Increases critical chance and critical damage
rune.insanesurvivaloverhaul.armor_pierce: Piercing damage: +%s per point of Attack Damage
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.unfa: Take a hit that would've killed you while well above half health, and walk away with a sliver of life instead.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.loose_world_respa: Your respawn point is loose, you'll respawn in a radius from world spawn.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.loose_bed_respawn: Your respawn point is loose, you'll respawn in a radius from your bed.
effect.insanesurvivaloverhaul.ghostly.de: You're hard to spot by monsters
insanesurvivaloverhaul.echo_pillar_catal: Use on a Echo Pillar to activate it.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.requires_catalyst: Can't activate. The Pillar requires a catalyst.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.pillar_disabled: Echo Pillar disabled. Players' respawn point has been reset.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.fail_echo_pillar: You couldn't respawn at the Pillar because it was disabled.
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.acti: Activate an Echo Pillar with an Echo Shard. Respawning here will give some effects.
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.crys: Craft a Crystal Heart to regain lost health.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.weak_hoe: This hoe is too weak to till soil
insanesurvivaloverhaul.milk_cooldown: This %s's fluid is not yet ready
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.mini: Mine an ore rock. They indicate a large ore vein below.
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.iron: Obtain an Iron Nugget by mining Stone
insanesurvivaloverhaul.fishing.low_fish: Fish are becoming scarce in this spot, maybe move a bit...
death.attack.collideWithWall.player: %1$s was doomed to hit a wall too hard by %2$s
insanesurvivaloverhaul.no_damage_item: This item is not sharp, hits like a fist
insanesurvivaloverhaul.no_mining_item: This item is old and rusty, can't mine anything
insanesurvivaloverhaul.disabled_item: This item is disabled and cannot be used/equipped
insanesurvivaloverhaul.broken_item: This item is broken, must be repaired
insanesurvivaloverhaul.pouch_weighted: Slowed down if carried more than %d
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.over: Get a movement speed penalty by carrying too many Pouches
insanesurvivaloverhaul.set_main_bed_with: Crouch right-click with an empty hand on the bed to set it as your main respawn bed. A main respawn bed will automatically be set as your respawn point if you lose another bed's respawn point.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.main_bed_set_as_r: Respawn point set at your main bed
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.chai: Obtain a Chainmail piece of armor
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.sack: Obtain a Sack with Cloth and a Chest
effect.insanesurvivaloverhaul.tired.desc: Obtained when haven't slept in a while. Slightly reduces movement, mining and attack speed.
insanesurvivaloverhaul.not_tired: You're not tired enough to sleep
insanesurvivaloverhaul.too_tired: You should really get some sleep before something gives you a visit
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.two_: Hold a Flint in each hand and right click a block to try and ignite it. Burn a tree down to get Charcoal.
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.char: Coal can only be obtained with an Iron pickaxe or higher. Obtain Charcoal by burning logs. A flint in both hands seems to do the job.
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.fire: Craft a Firestarter to create fire more consistently.
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.camp: Furnaces require Copper now. Burn a tree to get Charcoal and craft a Campfire to smelt some basic materials in the meantime.
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.torc: Obtain a Torch, the Campfire and some Sticks might come in handy
advancements.insanesurvivaloverhaul.anvi: Repair an Anvil with an Iron Block
death.fell.accident.water: %s thought could drop in shallow water safely
insanesurvivaloverhaul.requires_corners: The portal needs Crying Obsidian in the corners to be activated
emi.info.insanesurvivaloverhaul.items.na: When applied to a named entity will drop the previous name tag. If the item is not renamed will remove the name from the entity.
emi.info.insanesurvivaloverhaul.crops.se: Can be found in the wild
emi.info.insanesurvivaloverhaul.golden_p: Fastest speed powered rail, should not be used for slopes due to Minecarts being wonky
emi.info.insanesurvivaloverhaul.portal_c: To activate a nether portal, this block is required in the corners
